mars_base.label: Mars base
mars_base.source: One-way delay 4-24 min (default 20 min for demo); radiation from Curiosity RAD instrument; resupply window ~26 months (assumption).

mars_transit.label: Earth-Mars transit
mars_transit.source: Delay grows over the transit; fixed at a representative mid-transit value for the demo (assumption). No resupply in transit.

moon_base.label: Moon base
moon_base.source: ~1.3 s one-way light delay; resupply ~6 months (assumption).

assumptions.next_resupply_in_days: Demo assumption, not a NASA value: days until the next scheduled cargo for each context (Mars 380, Moon 120, ISS 45, transit none). Chosen so the seeded ~412-day stock covers the Mars window with a small margin.
assumptions.solar_storm_dose_msv: Assumption: a solar particle event adds a one-off dose, configurable 10-500 mSv (default 50 mSv, the order of magnitude of a sheltered crew in a large event).
assumptions.bone_loss_attenuation: Assumption: resistive exercise attenuates in-flight bone loss linearly, up to 50% at >= 2 h/day.
assumptions.kcal_per_kg: Approximation: 7700 kcal of cumulative energy imbalance per kg of body-mass change.

notes: Every value here is a NASA-informed reference or an explicitly flagged assumption, not a measured constant for this specific (fictional) crew. See PROMPT_FABLE.md §9 for sources; official NASA challenge resources for this cycle are expected 2026-11-13 and should be cross-checked then (docs/nasa-resources.md).
